title: Birds-Eye View
text: Transform front-facing camera image into top-down view, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Homography matrix} sets the transfer function derived from camera parameters, {Maximum buffer size, in pixels} sets the number of input pixels to buffer, {Number of input lines to buffer} sets the number of lines to transform, {Output active pixels} sets the horizontal size of output frame and {Output active lines} sets the vertical size of output frame. Values come from the instance.
